entries.test: The success rates reported for ELIZA and GPT-3.5 in arXiv 2310.20216 (Jones & Bergen), in the version current in December 2023.
entries.note: Early versions of the paper reported ELIZA at about 27% and GPT-3.5 at about 14%. Later revisions may report different numbers.

entries.test: Whether human witnesses in arXiv 2310.20216 had a higher pass rate than the best-performing AI witness.
entries.note: The proposition adds 'so the test has not been solved'. That is the post's thesis, but these words don't say it. It also widens the claim from the study's data to AI systems in general.

entries.test: Whether any AI system as of December 2023 had shown it could answer open-ended comprehension questions about arbitrary videos or TV shows, as Marcus's 2014 New Yorker Comprehension Challenge describes.
entries.note: No formal benchmark exists for the Comprehension Challenge, so the test relies on the plain reading of the 2014 proposal.

entries.test: Whether published evaluations as of December 2023 showed any system, including Gemini, coming near human-level open-ended video comprehension.
entries.note: 'Close' is vague, but most readers would read it the same way. Reports at the time said the Gemini demo video had been edited.
